## Description

Lists the data files in a directory, identified by extension (`dta`, `csv`, `xlsx`, `rds`, `parquet`, `sas7bdat`, archives and others; see the `extensions` variable in the script). When `generated/manifest[.tag].txt` and `generated/metadata[.tag].txt` exist (from [02_create_manifest.sh](#help-02_create_manifest)), it filters them instead of walking the file tree again.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/03_list_data_files.sh <directory> [tag] [zipfile]
```

- `directory` - Deposit directory, or another directory such as `restricted`.
- `tag` - Optional suffix for the input and output names.
- `zipfile` - Accepted for consistency; not used.

## Outputs

- `generated/data-list[.tag].txt` - Data files
- `generated/data-metadata[.tag].csv` - `filename,bytes`

See also [summarize_data.py](#help-summarize_data), which works from these lists.
